description: Sign a record of an action this agent took and add it to the Fabric Verify public log. Spends $0.005 of prepaid credit. The summary stays on this machine. The public log permanently holds only a salted SHA-256 fingerprint of the summary, the action kind and time, and coded identifiers that only the user, or an auditor they give an audit pack to, can link to this agent. Returns the record's log index; fetch its proof later with get_proof. A proof shows that this exact record existed, unchanged, by a certain time. It does not show that what the record describes is true.

approval_record.description: Optional. The record (payload_sha256) of an approval, when the account's governance policy requires one for this kind.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. If a call fails, retry with the same value (and the same kind and summary): the exact same signed record is resent and charged at most once.

summary.description: What the agent did, in plain words. Kept locally with the salt so the user can later show what the record was about. Not sent.

name: record_action
title: Record an agent action (costs $0.005)
